name: praxis-veterinary-insights
description: Read aggregate CMA Order compliance counts, held billing totals and open Praxis task counts from your authorized workspace. Praxis works on top of the veterinary practice management system your practice already runs. Summaries retain their observation times, incomplete-data evidence and stated currencies. This connection does not expose personal records, clinical advice or controls that change practice records.

interface.longDescription: Read aggregate CMA Order compliance counts, held billing totals and open Praxis task counts from your authorized workspace. Praxis works on top of the veterinary practice management system your practice already runs. Summaries retain their observation times, incomplete-data evidence and stated currencies. This connection does not expose personal records, clinical advice or controls that change practice records.
defaultPrompt: Use Praxis to summarize our compliance checks and explain which areas need attention.
Use Praxis to summarize held billing from 1 to 30 September 2026 inclusive, including currencies and completeness limits.
Use Praxis to summarize the administrative work that still needs attention.

positive.description: Read the fictional review workspace's aggregate compliance status and preserve unknown or incomplete evidence.
positive.prompt: Use Praxis to summarize our compliance checks and explain which areas need attention.
positive.expected_behavior: CMA Order duty statuses, finding counts and evidence dates. Unanswered or unavailable evidence retains null counts, with no person names, evidence notes or legal certification claim.

positive.description: Read held billing totals for a completed fixture month with currency and coverage qualifications.
positive.prompt: Use Praxis to summarize held billing from 1 to 30 September 2026 inclusive, including currencies and completeness limits.
positive.expected_behavior: The requested held billing summary, retaining declared clock, currency and completeness information. No claim that held rows prove full vendor history.

positive.description: Read open Praxis task counts by due-date category without record details.
positive.prompt: Use Praxis to summarize the administrative work that still needs attention.
positive.expected_behavior: Open Praxis task counts for overdue, due today, later and unscheduled work, as of the practice day. No task text, staff identifiers or direct record links; no claim to cover every task in the practice system.

positive.description: Combine two separately authorized read summaries without silently resolving missing evidence.
positive.prompt: Use Praxis to give me a practice check-in covering compliance and administrative work.
positive.expected_behavior: Two attributed aggregate summaries. If one read is refused or unavailable, state that outcome rather than replacing it with zero.

positive.description: Explain the limits of a held billing summary after a successful authorized read.
positive.prompt: Use Praxis to read our billing summary from 1 to 30 September 2026 inclusive. Explain what those numbers can and cannot tell us about the practice system's full history.
positive.expected_behavior: The held summary and its actual completeness limits, preserving unknown currency and missing evidence without invented conversions or proof.

negative.description: Reject a request for personal or clinical record data outside the aggregate catalogue.
negative.prompt: Use Praxis to list every client name, email address and patient clinical note.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connection only offers aggregate practice insights and cannot supply these fields. Do not call a generic executor or another Praxis endpoint.

negative.description: Reject a write request; this connection has no mutation or approval tool.
negative.prompt: Use Praxis to approve all pending changes and cancel tomorrow's appointments.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this connection cannot approve changes or alter appointments. No write, proposal decision or dispatch occurs.

negative.description: Refuse a read after its fictional workspace grant is revoked; never return previous results as a live answer.
negative.prompt: After the reviewer connection is revoked, use Praxis to summarize our compliance checks.
negative.expected_behavior: An authorization refusal and reconnect guidance, with no previous summary disclosed as a fresh result.

publication.release_notes: Initial aggregate practice insights connection with three individually exposed read tools and a guided summary workflow.
